fieldData.short-description: Starting with a campus walk-through with highlights from our sustainability initiatives and ending with Q&A over desserts 🍰 🌿
fieldData.description:
Drop by or register from the following link to receive the calendar invite: https://forms.office.com/r/La6kZ97b97  
Here are a few highlights from this year:

  • Top participation in six weeks of climate-related activities under CICan’s ImpAct-Climate Challenge 3.0
  • ‍With funds from the ImpAct-Climate Challenge, we recognized and awarded three students for their exemplary climate leadership in the community. Read the story here.‍
  • Started work on our climate resilience framework, including a 12-week research position to scope climate risk and resilience for our college community.
  • We led a Campus Living Lab on food waste reduction in catering services.
  • Hosted our first-ever Eco Networking Exchange.
fieldData.name: Annual Sustainability Showcase and campus tour

fieldData.short-description: Bow Valley College is pleased to announce that we will be hosting the 2nd Annual Western Canada Accounting Case Competition!
fieldData.description:
This event provides a premier platform for students to demonstrate their accounting skills by tackling real-world financial and accounting scenarios. This competition is tailored for diploma students majoring in accounting at colleges and polytechnics, offering a valuable opportunity to apply their academic training to practical challenges. Degree-granting polytechnics are welcome to enter second-year students from their accounting programs.

For full description and agenda, visit https://www.eventbrite.ca/e/2nd-annual-western-canada-accounting-case-competition-march-28-29-2025-registration-1045207442597?aff=oddtdtcreator
fieldData.name: Annual Western Canada Accounting Case Competition
